literature.headline_zh: 人肠道病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人肠道病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在人脑标本和小鼠模型中,EV-A71 感染后观察到脑干中的炎症细胞浸润和血脑屏障破坏。在致命的 EV-A71 病例中,C5a-C5aR1 轴被强烈激活。 [10.1371/journal.ppat.1014487]
我们发现,在免疫功能正常的 AFM 小鼠模型中针对 2014 年和 2016 年 EV-D68 分离株进行测试时,EV68-228-N 有效阻止了瘫痪的进展。 [10.17615/098g-fr47]
从机制上讲,我们表明 MATR3 通过其第二个 RNA 识别基序 (RRM2) 特异性结合 EV-A71 RNA 的 3' 非翻译区 (3'UTR)。 [10.1073/pnas.2608455123]
这两种病毒都感染类器官内的神经元群,其中 EV-A71 显示出更高的复制水平;转录组分析显示神经元和肌肉基因网络的下调,并且两种病毒都与 caspase-3 裂解增加和 SNAP25 的零星裂解有关。 [10.3390/v18080853]
EV-R 中的 VP1-145 取代破坏了原体间 E145-K244 相互作用,重新定位 K244,并增加了五倍顶点的局部静电势,顶点相邻密度与 VP1 K244 附近的芳环一致,并且 VP1 环中的局部结构差异。 [10.1038/s42003-026-10736-5]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Inflammatory cell infiltration in the brainstem and BBB disruption were observed following EV-A71 infection in human brain specimens and mouse models. The C5a-C5aR1 axis was robustly activated in fatal EV-A71 cases. [10.1371/journal.ppat.1014487]
We found that EV68-228-N effectively halted the progression of paralysis when tested against both 2014 and 2016 EV-D68 isolates in an immunocompetent mouse model of AFM. [10.17615/098g-fr47]
Mechanistically, we show that MATR3 specifically binds to the 3' untranslated region (3'UTR) of EV-A71 RNA via its second RNA recognition motif (RRM2). [10.1073/pnas.2608455123]

Both viruses infected neuronal populations within organoids, with EV-A71 showing higher replication levels; transcriptomic analysis revealed downregulation of neuronal and muscular gene networks, and both viruses were associated with increased cleaved caspase-3 and sporadic cleavage of SNAP25. [10.3390/v18080853]

A VP1-145 substitution in EV-R disrupts the interprotomer E145–K244 interaction, repositions K244, and increases local electrostatic potential at the fivefold vertex, with vertex-adjacent densities consistent with an aromatic ring near VP1 K244 and localized structural differences in VP1 loops. papers.title: The C5a-C5aR1 axis facilitates blood-brain barrier disruption induced by EV-A71 infection through neutrophil activation.
papers.abstract: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71), a member of the genus Enterovirus within the family Picornaviridae , induces neuroinflammation; however, the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. This study demonstrates that the C5a-C5aR1 axis plays a pivotal role in EV-A71-induced blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption and neuroinflammation, primarily by regulating neutrophil migration. Using human brain specimens and a mouse model, we observed pronounced inflammatory cell infiltration in the brainstem and BBB disruption following EV-A71 infection. Immunofluorescence analysis revealed robust activation of the C5a-C5aR1 axis in fatal EV-A71 cases. Notably, C5aR1 knockout (KO) mice displayed reduced Evans blue extravasation and preserved tight junction protein expression after infection. Immunopathological examination of fatal human cases further confirmed perivascular neutrophil (CD177+) infiltration in the brainstem. Importantly, C5aR1 deficiency significantly attenuated neutrophil accumulation and neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) release. Given that peptidylarginine deiminase 4 (PAD4) is a key enzyme driving NET formation, we generated neutrophil-specific PAD4 knockout mice (PAD4 Ne-KO) by crossing S100A8-Cre and PAD4 fl/fl lines. As anticipated, neutrophil-specific PAD4 deletion or pharmacological NET blockade substantially ameliorated BBB injury and neuroinflammation following EV-A71 infection. Overall, our findings underscore a critical role for the C5a-C5aR1-neutrophil/NETs pathway in EV-A71 encephalitis pathogenesis and support its targeting as a therapeutic strategy for critically ill patients.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to elucidate the mechanisms by which EV-A71 induces neuroinflammation and blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption, as the underlying processes remain incompletely understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized human brain specimens and a mouse model to investigate EV-A71-induced BBB disruption and neuroinflammation, focusing on the role of the C5a-C5aR1 axis in regulating neutrophil migration.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed immunofluorescence analysis to examine the activation of the C5a-C5aR1 axis in fatal EV-A71 cases and generated neutrophil-specific PAD4 knockout mice to study the role of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) in BBB injury.
analysis.main_results: Inflammatory cell infiltration in the brainstem and BBB disruption were observed following EV-A71 infection in human brain specimens and mouse models. The C5a-C5aR1 axis was robustly activated in fatal EV-A71 cases.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the critical role of the C5a-C5aR1-neutrophil/NETs pathway in EV-A71 encephalitis pathogenesis, offering a novel mechanism for BBB disruption and neuroinflammation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the pathogenesis of EV-A71 encephalitis and support the development of therapeutic strategies targeting the C5a-C5aR1 axis for critically ill patients.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on animal models and human brain specimens, which may not fully represent the complexity of human disease. However, the evidence is strong due to the direct observation of BBB disruption and the use of targeted genetic and pharmacological interventions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the mechanisms by which EV-A71 induces neuroinflammation and blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption. Using human brain specimens and a mouse model, the researchers observed pronounced inflammatory cell infiltration and BBB disruption following EV-A71 infection. Immunofluorescence analysis revealed robust activation of the C5a-C5aR1 axis in fatal cases, and C5aR1 knockout mice showed reduced BBB injury. The study highlights the critical role of the C5a-C5aR1-neutrophil/NETs pathway in EV-A71 encephalitis and suggests it as a potential therapeutic target. The findings are significant for understanding the pathogenesis of EV-A71 infections and may inform future research and treatment strategies. However, the study's reliance on animal models and limited human data may affect the generalizability of the results.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用人脑标本和小鼠模型来研究 EV-A71 诱导的 BBB 破坏和神经炎症,重点关注 C5a-C5aR1 轴在调节中性粒细胞迁移中的作用。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 EV-A71 脑炎 发病机制 的深入了解,并支持针对危重患者开发针对 C5a-C5aR1 轴的治疗策略。

papers.title: The EV-A71 RNA-binding protein Matrin 3 facilitates viral replication by stabilizing viral RNA via ZDHHC20-mediated palmitoylation.
papers.abstract: Enterovirus 71 (EV-A71) is a major causative agent of severe hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) in young children. However, the molecular interplay between EV-A71 and host factors, particularly how these interactions govern viral replication, remains incompletely understood. To systematically identify host factors involved in EV-A71 infection, we performed comprehensive identification of RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) by mass spectrometry (ChIRP-MS) during viral infection and identified 374 host proteins associated with the EV-A71 genomic RNA. Integrative analysis of existing datasets further revealed a broader association between Matrin 3 (MATR3) and enteroviruses, which we functionally validated through gain- and loss-of-function assays, demonstrating that MATR3 acts as a proviral factor essential for efficient EV-A71 replication. Mechanistically, we show that MATR3 specifically binds to the 3' untranslated region (3'UTR) of EV-A71 RNA via its second RNA recognition motif (RRM2). This interaction promotes RNA-dependent condensate formation of MATR3, thereby enhancing viral RNA stability. Furthermore, MATR3 recruits the host palmitoyltransferase ZDHHC20 to the viral ribonucleoprotein complex, facilitating MATR3 palmitoylation. This posttranslational modification promotes the assembly of a stable ribonucleoprotein complex that cooperatively stabilizes the viral genome and supports efficient replication. Together, this study delineates a mechanistic pathway by which EV-A71 co-opts MATR3 through condensate formation and palmitoylation to stabilize its genomic RNA and promote viral replication, and provides a comprehensive profiling dataset of host proteins associated with EV-A71 RNA.

papers.title_zh: EV-A71 RNA 结合蛋白 Matrin 3 通过 ZDHHC20 介导的棕榈酰化稳定病毒 RNA,从而促进病毒复制。
papers.source_body_en: Enterovirus 71 (EV-A71) is a major causative agent of severe hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) in young children. However, the molecular interplay between EV-A71 and host factors, particularly how these interactions govern viral replication, remains incompletely understood. To systematically identify host factors involved in EV-A71 infection, we performed comprehensive identification of RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) by mass spectrometry (ChIRP-MS) during viral infection and identified 374 host proteins associated with the EV-A71 genomic RNA. Integrative analysis of existing datasets further revealed a broader association between Matrin 3 (MATR3) and enteroviruses, which we functionally validated through gain- and loss-of-function assays, demonstrating that MATR3 acts as a proviral factor essential for efficient EV-A71 replication. Mechanistically, we show that MATR3 specifically binds to the 3' untranslated region (3'UTR) of EV-A71 RNA via its second RNA recognition motif (RRM2). This interaction promotes RNA-dependent condensate formation of MATR3, thereby enhancing viral RNA stability. Furthermore, MATR3 recruits the host palmitoyltransferase ZDHHC20 to the viral ribonucleoprotein complex, facilitating MATR3 palmitoylation. This posttranslational modification promotes the assembly of a stable ribonucleoprotein complex that cooperatively stabilizes the viral genome and supports efficient replication. Together, this study delineates a mechanistic pathway by which EV-A71 co-opts MATR3 through condensate formation and palmitoylation to stabilize its genomic RNA and promote viral replication, and provides a comprehensive profiling dataset of host proteins associated with EV-A71 RNA.
papers.abstract_zh: 肠道病毒 71 (EV-A71) 是幼儿严重手足口病 (HFMD) 的主要病原体。然而,EV-A71 和 宿主 因子之间的分子相互作用,特别是这些相互作用如何控制病毒复制,仍不完全清楚。为了系统地鉴定参与 EV-A71 感染的 宿主 因子,我们在病毒感染过程中通过质谱 (ChIRP-MS) 对 RNA 结合蛋白 (RBP) 进行了全面鉴定,并鉴定了 374 个与 EV-A71 基因组 RNA 相关的 宿主 蛋白。对现有数据集的综合分析进一步揭示了 Matrin 3 (MATR3) 和肠道病毒之间更广泛的关联,我们通过功能获得和功能丧失测定对其进行了功能验证,证明 MATR3 作为有效 EV-A71 复制所必需的前病毒因子。从机制上讲,我们表明 MATR3 通过其第二个 RNA 识别基序 (RRM2) 特异性结合 EV-A71 RNA 的 3' 非翻译区 (3'UTR)。这种相互作用促进 MATR3 的 RNA 依赖性凝聚体形成,从而增强病毒 RNA 的稳定性。此外,MATR3 将 宿主 棕榈酰转移酶 ZDHHC20 招募到病毒核糖核蛋白复合物中,促进 MATR3 棕榈酰化。这种翻译后修饰促进稳定核糖核蛋白复合物的组装,从而协同稳定病毒 基因组 并支持有效复制。总之,这项研究描绘了 EV-A71 通过缩合形成和棕榈酰化来选择 MATR3 来稳定其基因组 RNA 并促进病毒复制的机制途径,并提供了与 EV-A71 RNA 相关的 宿主 蛋白的全面分析数据集。

papers.title: EV68-228-N monoclonal antibody treatment halts progression of paralysis in a mouse model of EV-D68 induced acute flaccid myelitis.
papers.abstract: In 2014, 2016, and 2018, infection with enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) was associated with outbreaks of a poliomyelitis-like paralytic syndrome, called acute flaccid myelitis (AFM). While only a small fraction of patients infected with EV-D68 developed AFM, this subgroup of patients does not typically seek treatment until after the onset of neurological symptoms. There are currently no approved human monoclonal antibody therapies or vaccines available for EV-D68. Here, we show that a monoclonal antibody, EV68-228-N, can quickly stop the progression of paralysis in a mouse model of AFM, even when treatment is initiated after the onset of paralysis. We found that EV68-228-N effectively halted the progression of paralysis when tested against both 2014 and 2016 EV-D68 isolates in an immunocompetent mouse model of AFM. All animal experiments were conducted in a blinded fashion. The IC 50 of EV68-228-N against 2014 and 2016 EV-D68 isolates was confirmed in vitro to be less than 330 ng/mL, and EV68-228-N was found to be equally effective at neutralizing 2018 and 2022 viral isolates without any evidence of emerging resistance. We further show that, following infection with EV-D68, mice treated with EV68-228-N have more surviving motor neurons in the spinal cord's lumbar enlargement than control treated animals. Taken together, this work suggests that EV68-228-N treatment has the potential to halt the progression of paralysis in AFM patients who present at the clinic with neurologic symptoms and that EV68-228-N will retain neutralization potential against emerging EV-D68 isolates. IMPORTANCE: Enterovirus D-68 (EV-D68) associated acute flaccid myelitis (AFM) is an emergent poliomyelitis-like illness occurring predominantly in children. There are currently no proven effective therapies. We describe the use of a human monoclonal antibody (EV68-228-N) in a murine model of EV-D68 AFM in which therapy prevents progression of paralysis even when treatment is instituted after onset of weakness. CLINICAL TRIALS: This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov as NCT06444048.

papers.title_zh: EV68-228-N 单克隆抗体 治疗 可阻止 EV-D68 诱导的 急性弛缓性脊髓炎 小鼠模型的瘫痪进展。
papers.source_body_en: In 2014, 2016, and 2018, infection with enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) was associated with outbreaks of a poliomyelitis-like paralytic syndrome, called acute flaccid myelitis (AFM). While only a small fraction of patients infected with EV-D68 developed AFM, this subgroup of patients does not typically seek treatment until after the onset of neurological symptoms. There are currently no approved human monoclonal antibody therapies or vaccines available for EV-D68. Here, we show that a monoclonal antibody, EV68-228-N, can quickly stop the progression of paralysis in a mouse model of AFM, even when treatment is initiated after the onset of paralysis. We found that EV68-228-N effectively halted the progression of paralysis when tested against both 2014 and 2016 EV-D68 isolates in an immunocompetent mouse model of AFM. All animal experiments were conducted in a blinded fashion. The IC 50 of EV68-228-N against 2014 and 2016 EV-D68 isolates was confirmed in vitro to be less than 330 ng/mL, and EV68-228-N was found to be equally effective at neutralizing 2018 and 2022 viral isolates without any evidence of emerging resistance. We further show that, following infection with EV-D68, mice treated with EV68-228-N have more surviving motor neurons in the spinal cord's lumbar enlargement than control treated animals. Taken together, this work suggests that EV68-228-N treatment has the potential to halt the progression of paralysis in AFM patients who present at the clinic with neurologic symptoms and that EV68-228-N will retain neutralization potential against emerging EV-D68 isolates. IMPORTANCE: Enterovirus D-68 (EV-D68) associated acute flaccid myelitis (AFM) is an emergent poliomyelitis-like illness occurring predominantly in children. There are currently no proven effective therapies. We describe the use of a human monoclonal antibody (EV68-228-N) in a murine model of EV-D68 AFM in which therapy prevents progression of paralysis even when treatment is instituted after onset of weakness. CLINICAL TRIALS: This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov as NCT06444048.
papers.abstract_zh: 2014年、2016年和2018年,肠道病毒D68(EV-D68)感染与脊髓灰质炎样麻痹综合征(称为急性弛缓性脊髓炎(AFM))的暴发相关。虽然只有一小部分感染 EV-D68 的患者出现 AFM,但该亚组患者通常直到出现神经系统症状后才会寻求 治疗。目前尚无批准的人单克隆抗体疗法或 疫苗 可用于 EV-D68。在这里,我们证明单克隆抗体 EV68-228-N 可以快速阻止 AFM 小鼠模型中的麻痹进展,即使在麻痹发作后启动 治疗 也是如此。我们发现,在免疫功能正常的 AFM 小鼠模型中针对 2014 年和 2016 年 EV-D68 分离株进行测试时,EV68-228-N 有效阻止了瘫痪的进展。所有动物实验均以盲法进行。体外证实 EV68-228-N 针对 2014 年和 2016 年 EV-D68 分离株的 IC 50 低于 330 ng/mL,并且发现 EV68-228-N 在中和 2018 年和 2022 年病毒分离株方面同样有效,没有任何出现耐药性的证据。我们进一步表明,感染 EV-D68 后,用 EV68-228-N 治疗的小鼠在脊髓腰部增大中比对照治疗的动物有更多的存活运动神经元。总而言之,这项工作表明,EV68-228-N 治疗 有可能阻止在诊所出现神经系统症状的 AFM 患者的瘫痪进展,并且 EV68-228-N 将保留针对新出现的 EV-D68 分离株的中和潜力。重要性:肠道病毒 D-68 (EV-D68) 相关 急性弛缓性脊髓炎 (AFM) 是一种主要发生于儿童的新发脊髓灰质炎样疾病。目前尚无经过证实的有效疗法。我们描述了在 EV-D68 AFM 小鼠模型中使用人单克隆抗体 (EV68-228-N),即使在无力发作后开始使用 治疗,该疗法也能防止瘫痪进展。临床试验:本研究在 ClinicalTrials.gov 注册为 NCT06444048。

papers.title: Genetic variation, recombinant characteristics, and seroprevalence analysis of echovirus 3 causing severe and mild cases of hand, foot, and mouth disease in Guizhou Province
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Echovirus 3 (E-3) has recently been identified as an emerging pathogen associated with both severe and mild cases of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) in Guizhou Province, China. Although these strains exhibit distinct clinical phenotypes, their underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear. This study reports the phylogenetic and genetic features of eight E-3 strains from severe and mild HFMD cases and investigates E-3 seroprevalence in Guizhou. Eight shared nucleotide substitutions in the untranslated regions (UTRs) and six shared amino acid substitutions in the open reading frame (ORF) were identified between E-3 strains from severe and mild case groups. Nine variant-specific amino acid mutations were under positive selection and exhibited high variability. Among the 115 nucleotide substitutions in the ORF regions, 31 were specific to the severe case group and 41 to the mild case group. Recombination analysis revealed that the Guizhou E-3 strains underwent complex interserotypic recombination with echovirus 21 (E-21), enterovirus B80 (EV-B80), and echovirus 30 (E-30). E-3 strains from the severe case group demonstrated enhanced replication efficiency, higher viral titers, and greater cytopathogenicity than those from the mild case group. Analysis of 178 samples revealed a seropositivity rate of 52.25% and a geometric mean titer (GMT) of 1:28.23 for E-3, indicating the prevalence of asymptomatic infections in Guizhou Province. All Guizhou E-3 strains exhibited non-temperature-sensitive characteristics, suggesting their potential for transmissibility within the population. This study provides valuable insights for global studies on E-3-related diseases and molecular epidemiology, establishing a foundation for further investigation into the pathogenicity of E-3 variants. IMPORTANCE This study is the first report of echovirus 3 (E-3) infections associated with severe hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) cases in Guizhou Province, China. All E-3 strains showed thermotolerance and higher seroprevalence, suggesting potentially enhanced transmissibility. Several shared nucleotide substitutions and amino acid substitutions were identified in Guizhou strains from both severe and mild case groups, indicating that E-3 may have evolved through continuous genetic adaptation, potentially driving the emergence of more transmissible epidemic variants. This study revealed that the E-3 strains in the severe case group exhibited enhanced replication efficiency, higher viral titers, and increased cytopathogenicity in vitro , thereby providing evidence to support a potential association between genetic variations and clinical severity. Notably, all E-3-infected patients in the severe case group exhibited more severe clinical manifestations. These findings provide critical updates on the epidemiological trends of enteroviruses associated with HFMD and establish a foundation for a better understanding of genetic diversity, evolutionary patterns, and molecular mechanisms of enterovirus infections.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed eight E-3 strains from severe and mild HFMD cases and examined seroprevalence in Guizhou Province using 178 samples. It focused on the molecular features of these strains and their association with clinical severity.
analysis.methods: The study employed phylogenetic analysis, recombination analysis, and seroprevalence testing to compare genetic features between E-3 strains from severe and mild HFMD cases. It also assessed replication efficiency, viral titers, and cytopathogenicity in vitro.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the genetic diversity and potential for enhanced transmissibility of E-3, which could inform surveillance, diagnosis, and prevention strategies for HFMD in Guizhou Province and other regions with similar epidemiological patterns.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single geographic region and the use of in vitro data. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查中国贵州省埃可病毒 3 型 (E-3) 与严重和轻度手足口病 (HFMD) 病例相关的遗传变异和重组特征,因为 E-3 最近被确定为与这两种临床结果相关的新兴病原体。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了来自严重和轻度手足口病病例的 8 个 E-3 菌株,并使用 178 个样本对贵州省的 血清流行率 进行了检查。它重点关注这些菌株的分子特征及其与临床严重程度的关联。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用系统发育分析、重组分析和 血清流行率 测试来比较严重和轻度手足口病病例的 E-3 菌株之间的遗传特征。它还评估了体外复制效率、病毒滴度和细胞致病性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在来自重症和轻度病例组的 E-3 菌株之间发现了非翻译区 (UTR) 中的 8 个共享核苷酸替换和开放阅读框 (ORF) 中的 6 个共享氨基酸替换。此外,31个核苷酸替换是重症组特有的,而41个核苷酸替换是轻度病例组特有的。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,E-3 的遗传变异可能导致临床严重程度的差异,严重病例菌株表现出复制效率增强、病毒滴度更高和细胞致病性增加。这些结果为 E-3 致病性的分子机制提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调了E-3的遗传多样性和增强传播性的潜力,这可以为监测、诊断以及贵州省和其他流行病学模式相似地区的手足口病预防策略提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其关注单一地理区域和体外数据的使用而受到限制。然而,由于详细的遗传和 血清流行率 分析,证据是强有力的,并且这些发现得到了对核苷酸和氨基酸取代的多次观察的支持。

papers.title_zh: 贵州省引起重症和轻症手足口病的埃可病毒3型遗传变异、重组特征及血清流行率分析
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Echovirus 3 (E-3) has recently been identified as an emerging pathogen associated with both severe and mild cases of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) in Guizhou Province, China. Although these strains exhibit distinct clinical phenotypes, their underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear. This study reports the phylogenetic and genetic features of eight E-3 strains from severe and mild HFMD cases and investigates E-3 seroprevalence in Guizhou. Eight shared nucleotide substitutions in the untranslated regions (UTRs) and six shared amino acid substitutions in the open reading frame (ORF) were identified between E-3 strains from severe and mild case groups. Nine variant-specific amino acid mutations were under positive selection and exhibited high variability. Among the 115 nucleotide substitutions in the ORF regions, 31 were specific to the severe case group and 41 to the mild case group. Recombination analysis revealed that the Guizhou E-3 strains underwent complex interserotypic recombination with echovirus 21 (E-21), enterovirus B80 (EV-B80), and echovirus 30 (E-30). E-3 strains from the severe case group demonstrated enhanced replication efficiency, higher viral titers, and greater cytopathogenicity than those from the mild case group. Analysis of 178 samples revealed a seropositivity rate of 52.25% and a geometric mean titer (GMT) of 1:28.23 for E-3, indicating the prevalence of asymptomatic infections in Guizhou Province. All Guizhou E-3 strains exhibited non-temperature-sensitive characteristics, suggesting their potential for transmissibility within the population. This study provides valuable insights for global studies on E-3-related diseases and molecular epidemiology, establishing a foundation for further investigation into the pathogenicity of E-3 variants. IMPORTANCE This study is the first report of echovirus 3 (E-3) infections associated with severe hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) cases in Guizhou Province, China. All E-3 strains showed thermotolerance and higher seroprevalence, suggesting potentially enhanced transmissibility. Several shared nucleotide substitutions and amino acid substitutions were identified in Guizhou strains from both severe and mild case groups, indicating that E-3 may have evolved through continuous genetic adaptation, potentially driving the emergence of more transmissible epidemic variants. This study revealed that the E-3 strains in the severe case group exhibited enhanced replication efficiency, higher viral titers, and increased cytopathogenicity in vitro , thereby providing evidence to support a potential association between genetic variations and clinical severity. Notably, all E-3-infected patients in the severe case group exhibited more severe clinical manifestations. These findings provide critical updates on the epidemiological trends of enteroviruses associated with HFMD and establish a foundation for a better understanding of genetic diversity, evolutionary patterns, and molecular mechanisms of enterovirus infections.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查中国贵州省埃可病毒 3 型 (E-3) 与严重和轻度手足口病 (HFMD) 病例相关的遗传变异和重组特征,因为 E-3 最近被确定为与这两种临床结果相关的新兴病原体。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了来自严重和轻度手足口病病例的 8 个 E-3 菌株,并使用 178 个样本对贵州省的 血清流行率 进行了检查。它重点关注这些菌株的分子特征及其与临床严重程度的关联。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用系统发育分析、重组分析和 血清流行率 测试来比较严重和轻度手足口病病例的 E-3 菌株之间的遗传特征。它还评估了体外复制效率、病毒滴度和细胞致病性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在来自重症和轻度病例组的 E-3 菌株之间发现了非翻译区 (UTR) 中的 8 个共享核苷酸替换和开放阅读框 (ORF) 中的 6 个共享氨基酸替换。此外,31个核苷酸替换是重症组特有的,而41个核苷酸替换是轻度病例组特有的。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,E-3 的遗传变异可能导致临床严重程度的差异,严重病例菌株表现出复制效率增强、病毒滴度更高和细胞致病性增加。这些结果为 E-3 致病性的分子机制提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调了E-3的遗传多样性和增强传播性的潜力,这可以为监测、诊断以及贵州省和其他流行病学模式相似地区的手足口病预防策略提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其关注单一地理区域和体外数据的使用而受到限制。然而,由于详细的遗传和 血清流行率 分析,证据是强有力的,并且这些发现得到了对核苷酸和氨基酸取代的多次观察的支持。

papers.title: Epidemiological Characteristics of Enterovirus Infection in the Far Eastern Federal District in Long-Term Dynamics (2006–2024)
papers.abstract: The incidence of enterovirus infections (EVI) in the Russian Federation increases in the summer-autumn period, with outbreaks occurring. The highest incidence rates recorded in the Ural and Far Eastern Federal Districts. To study the manifestations of the EVI epidemic process in the Far Eastern Federal District in 2006–2024. Materials and Methods . A retrospective epidemiological analysis of EVI incidence in the subjects of the Far Eastern Federal District conducted using nonparametric and parametric statistical methods. In the Far Eastern Federal District a trend toward a moderate increase in EVI incidence with an increase in the registration of outbreaks has been identified. Most cases of infection occur in children aged 0 to 6 years, with children aged 1–2 years and up to one year being at risk. Increases in the incidence of enterovirus infections are largely associated with the circulation of certain enterovirus genotypes, with Enterovirus alphacoxsackie species predominating in the etiologic structure since 2017. A downward trend in the incidence of enteroviral meningitis has been observed. Among the clinical manifestations of enterovirus infections, the incidence of herpangina and exanthemic forms has increased. alphacoxsackie species could has lead to a change in the clinical patterns of enterovirus infections and, likely, the age distribution of affected children, as well as an increase in outbreaks. Multiple transmission routes, high contagiousness, and prolonged shedding of E. alphacoxsackie species require anti-epidemic measures not only during the seasonal but also during the interepidemic period.

analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective epidemiological analysis of EVI incidence in the Far Eastern Federal District was conducted using nonparametric and parametric statistical methods. The highest incidence rates were recorded in the Ural and Far Eastern Federal Districts.
analysis.methods: The study involved a retrospective epidemiological analysis of EVI incidence in the Far Eastern Federal District, utilizing nonparametric and parametric statistical methods to examine the epidemic process.
analysis.main_results: A trend toward a moderate increase in EVI incidence with an increase in the registration of outbreaks has been identified. The incidence of herpangina and exanthemic forms has increased among the clinical manifestations of enterovirus infections.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the circulation of certain enterovirus genotypes, particularly Enterovirus alphacoxsackie species, has led to changes in the clinical patterns of enterovirus infections and likely affected the age distribution of infected children.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the need for anti-epidemic measures not only during the seasonal outbreaks but also during the interepidemic period to address the increasing incidence of enterovirus infections.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the long-term dynamics of enterovirus infections (EVI) in the Far Eastern Federal District of Russia from 2006 to 2024. It identifies a moderate increase in EVI incidence alongside more frequent outbreaks, with a notable rise in herpangina and exanthemic forms. The research suggests that the predominance of Enterovirus alphacoxsackie species since 2017 may have altered clinical patterns and age distribution of affected children. The findings emphasize the importance of implementing anti-epidemic measures beyond seasonal periods. However, the study's retrospective design limits its ability to establish causality, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

The highest incidence rates recorded in the Ural and Far Eastern Federal Districts. To study the manifestations of the EVI epidemic process in the Far Eastern Federal District in 2006–2024. Materials and Methods . A retrospective epidemiological analysis of EVI incidence in the subjects of the Far Eastern Federal District conducted using nonparametric and parametric statistical methods. In the Far Eastern Federal District a trend toward a moderate increase in EVI incidence with an increase in the registration of outbreaks has been identified. Most cases of infection occur in children aged 0 to 6 years, with children aged 1–2 years and up to one year being at risk. Increases in the incidence of enterovirus infections are largely associated with the circulation of certain enterovirus genotypes, with Enterovirus alphacoxsackie species predominating in the etiologic structure since 2017. A downward trend in the incidence of enteroviral meningitis has been observed. Among the clinical manifestations of enterovirus infections, the incidence of herpangina and exanthemic forms has increased. alphacoxsackie species could has lead to a change in the clinical patterns of enterovirus infections and, likely, the age distribution of affected children, as well as an increase in outbreaks. Multiple transmission routes, high contagiousness, and prolonged shedding of E. alphacoxsackie species require anti-epidemic measures not only during the seasonal but also during the interepidemic period.

papers.title: Sulfated PSGL-1 primes the enterovirus A71 fivefold vertex for localized remodeling
papers.abstract: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) causes hand, foot, and mouth disease and poses a significant public health threat through severe neurological complications in pediatric cases. P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 (PSGL-1) functions as an attachment factor, yet the structural basis of PSGL-1 recognition on the EV-A71 capsid has remained undefined. Here, we use cryo-EM to compare a PSGL-1–non-binding EV-A71 strain (EV-V) with a PSGL-1–binding strain (EV-R) and analyzeEV-R particles incubated with a sulfated 20-residue PSGL-1 N-terminal peptide (sPSGL-1; residues 42–61). In EV-R, a VP1-145 substitution disrupts the interprotomer E145–K244 interaction, repositions K244, and increases local electrostatic potential at the fivefold vertex. A fivefold-focused, symmetry-relaxed (C1; no symmetry imposed) 2.38 Å reconstruction reveals low-occupancy, vertex-adjacent densities associated with sPSGL-1 incubation, including a locally interpretable density feature consistent with an aromatic ring near VP1 K244, together with localized structural differences in VP1 loops and pocket-adjacent regions. The pocket factor and VP4 remain present, and electrostatic mapping localizes this signal within a lysine-rich vertex cleft. These observations are consistent with localized fivefold-vertex priming without evidence for an uncoating-associated A-particle transition within the compact/closed population analyzed. Cryo-EM reveals how sulfated PSGL-1 engages the EV-A71 fivefold vertex through electrostatic interactions, priming localized structural changes that facilitate early-stage receptor recognition without triggering global uncoating.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) causes severe neurological complications in pediatric hand, foot, and mouth disease, yet the structural basis of its recognition by the attachment factor P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 (PSGL-1) remains undefined.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used cryo-electron microscopy to compare a PSGL-1–non-binding EV-A71 strain (EV-V) with a PSGL-1–binding strain (EV-R) and analyzed EV-R particles incubated with a sulfated 20-residue PSGL-1 N-terminal peptide (sPSGL-1; residues 42–61).
analysis.methods: Cryo-EM reconstructions were performed with symmetry-relaxed (C1) conditions to a 2.38 Å resolution, focusing on the fivefold vertex of EV-R particles to detect low-occupancy densities and localized structural changes associated with sPSGL-1 incubation.
analysis.main_results: A VP1-145 substitution in EV-R disrupts the interprotomer E145–K244 interaction, repositions K244, and increases local electrostatic potential at the fivefold vertex, with vertex-adjacent densities consistent with an aromatic ring near VP1 K244 and localized structural differences in VP1 loops.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal that sulfated PSGL-1 primes the EV-A71 fivefold vertex through electrostatic interactions, inducing localized structural remodeling that facilitates early-stage receptor recognition without triggering global uncoating, representing a newly defined mechanism of receptor engagement.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This structural insight into EV-A71–PSGL-1 interactions may inform the design of antiviral strategies targeting receptor binding or capsid priming, potentially improving surveillance and therapeutic approaches for severe EV-A71 infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study analyzed a compact/closed particle population and did not observe uncoating-associated A-particle transitions, limiting conclusions about later-stage receptor-mediated entry events; the evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of functional validation beyond structural observations.

analysis.summary_en: This study resolves how sulfated PSGL-1 primes the EV-A71 capsid for receptor engagement by inducing localized structural remodeling at the fivefold vertex. Using cryo-EM, the authors show that a VP1-145 substitution in a PSGL-1–binding strain (EV-R) disrupts interprotomer interactions, increases local electrostatic potential, and creates a lysine-rich cleft that accommodates sPSGL-1 without triggering global uncoating. The work defines a new mechanism of early-stage receptor recognition for EV-A71, highlighting potential targets for antiviral design while acknowledging that later entry stages and functional consequences remain unexamined.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) causes severe neurological complications in pediatric hand, foot, and mouth disease, yet the structural basis of its recognition by the attachment factor P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 (PSGL-1) remains undefined.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study used cryo-electron microscopy to compare a PSGL-1–non-binding EV-A71 strain (EV-V) with a PSGL-1–binding strain (EV-R) and analyzed EV-R particles incubated with a sulfated 20-residue PSGL-1 N-terminal peptide (sPSGL-1; residues 42–61).
analysis_en.methods: Cryo-EM reconstructions were performed with symmetry-relaxed (C1) conditions to a 2.38 Å resolution, focusing on the fivefold vertex of EV-R particles to detect low-occupancy densities and localized structural changes associated with sPSGL-1 incubation.
analysis_en.main_results: A VP1-145 substitution in EV-R disrupts the interprotomer E145–K244 interaction, repositions K244, and increases local electrostatic potential at the fivefold vertex, with vertex-adjacent densities consistent with an aromatic ring near VP1 K244 and localized structural differences in VP1 loops.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal that sulfated PSGL-1 primes the EV-A71 fivefold vertex through electrostatic interactions, inducing localized structural remodeling that facilitates early-stage receptor recognition without triggering global uncoating, representing a newly defined mechanism of receptor engagement.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This structural insight into EV-A71–PSGL-1 interactions may inform the design of antiviral strategies targeting receptor binding or capsid priming, potentially improving surveillance and therapeutic approaches for severe EV-A71 infections.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study analyzed a compact/closed particle population and did not observe uncoating-associated A-particle transitions, limiting conclusions about later-stage receptor-mediated entry events; the evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of functional validation beyond structural observations.

papers.title_zh: 硫酸化 PSGL-1 启动肠道病毒 A71 五重顶点进行局部重塑
papers.source_body_en: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) causes hand, foot, and mouth disease and poses a significant public health threat through severe neurological complications in pediatric cases. P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 (PSGL-1) functions as an attachment factor, yet the structural basis of PSGL-1 recognition on the EV-A71 capsid has remained undefined. Here, we use cryo-EM to compare a PSGL-1–non-binding EV-A71 strain (EV-V) with a PSGL-1–binding strain (EV-R) and analyzeEV-R particles incubated with a sulfated 20-residue PSGL-1 N-terminal peptide (sPSGL-1; residues 42–61). In EV-R, a VP1-145 substitution disrupts the interprotomer E145–K244 interaction, repositions K244, and increases local electrostatic potential at the fivefold vertex. A fivefold-focused, symmetry-relaxed (C1; no symmetry imposed) 2.38 Å reconstruction reveals low-occupancy, vertex-adjacent densities associated with sPSGL-1 incubation, including a locally interpretable density feature consistent with an aromatic ring near VP1 K244, together with localized structural differences in VP1 loops and pocket-adjacent regions. The pocket factor and VP4 remain present, and electrostatic mapping localizes this signal within a lysine-rich vertex cleft. These observations are consistent with localized fivefold-vertex priming without evidence for an uncoating-associated A-particle transition within the compact/closed population analyzed. Cryo-EM reveals how sulfated PSGL-1 engages the EV-A71 fivefold vertex through electrostatic interactions, priming localized structural changes that facilitate early-stage receptor recognition without triggering global uncoating.
papers.abstract_zh: 肠道病毒 A71 (EV-A71) 会引起手足口病,并通过儿科病例中的严重神经系统并发症对公共健康构成重大威胁。P-选择素糖蛋白配体-1 (PSGL-1) 作为附着因子发挥作用,但 EV-A71 衣壳上 PSGL-1 识别的结构基础仍不清楚。在这里,我们使用冷冻电镜比较 PSGL-1 非结合 EV-A71 菌株 (EV-V) 与 PSGL-1 结合菌株 (EV-R),并分析与硫酸化 20 残基 PSGL-1 N 端肽(sPSGL-1;残基 42-61)一起孵育的 EV-R 颗粒。在 EV-R 中,VP1-145 取代破坏了原体间 E145-K244 相互作用,重新定位 K244,并增加了五倍顶点的局部静电势。五重聚焦、对称松弛(C1;未施加对称性)2.38 Å 重建揭示了与 sPSGL-1 孵化相关的低占用率、顶点相邻密度,包括与 VP1 K244 附近的芳香环一致的局部可解释密度特征,以及 VP1 环和口袋相邻区域中的局部结构差异。口袋因子和 VP4 仍然存在,并且静电映射将该信号定位在富含赖氨酸的顶点裂隙内。这些观察结果与局部五重顶点引发一致,没有证据表明所分析的紧凑/封闭群体内存在与脱涂层相关的 A 粒子转变。冷冻电镜揭示了硫酸化 PSGL-1 如何通过静电相互作用接合 EV-A71 五重顶点,引发局部结构变化,从而促进早期受体识别,而不触发整体脱涂层。

papers.title: Non-Polio Enterovirus A71 and D68 Infection of Human Neuromuscular Organoids Reveals Distinct Mechanisms of Neuromuscular Impairment
papers.abstract: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) and enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) are recognised as causative agents of severe neurological complications, including acute flaccid myelitis (AFM). However, the molecular mechanisms underlying the neurovirulence and effects on neuromuscular integrity remain poorly understood. Here, we employed human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neuromuscular organoids (NMOs) to investigate the cellular tropism and pathogenic effects of EV-A71 and EV-D68 in a human-relevant context. Both viruses infected neuronal populations within NMOs, with EV-A71 exhibiting higher levels of viral replication than EV-D68. Transcriptomic analysis revealed downregulation of neuronal and muscular gene networks following infection. EV-A71 preferentially suppressed neuronal pathways, while both viruses exerted comparable effects on muscle-associated gene expression. These transcriptional changes highlighted alterations in pathways governing neuronal and muscle function and communication, prompting examination of synaptic vesicle machinery components. At the protein level, both viruses were associated with sporadic cleavage of the neuronal SNARE protein synaptosomal-associated protein 25 (SNAP25). In addition, infection with either virus increased cleaved caspase-3 levels, consistent with activation of apoptotic signalling. Together, these findings indicate virus-specific downstream effects and establish NMOs as a robust platform for dissecting enterovirus–host interactions relevant to AFM.

papers.abstract_zh: 肠道病毒 A71 (EV-A71) 和肠道病毒 D68 (EV-D68) 被认为是严重神经系统并发症的病原体,包括 急性弛缓性脊髓炎 (AFM)。然而,神经毒力和对神经肌肉完整性影响的分子机制仍然知之甚少。在这里,我们采用人类诱导多能干细胞衍生的神经肌肉类器官(NMO)来研究 EV-A71 和 EV-D68 在人类相关背景下的细胞趋向性和致病作用。这两种病毒都感染 NMO 内的神经元群,其中 EV-A71 表现出比 EV-D68 更高的病毒复制水平。转录组分析显示感染后神经元和肌肉基因网络下调。EV-A71优先抑制神经元通路,而两种病毒对肌肉相关基因表达的影响相当。这些转录变化突出了控制神经元和肌肉功能和通讯的途径的改变,促使人们对突触小泡机械组件进行检查。在蛋白质水平上,两种病毒都与神经元 SNARE 蛋白突触体相关蛋白 25 (SNAP25) 的零星裂解有关。此外,这两种病毒的感染都会增加裂解的 caspase-3 水平,这与细胞凋亡信号传导的激活一致。总之,这些发现表明了病毒特异性的下游效应,并将 NMO 建立为剖析与 AFM 相关的肠道病毒 - 宿主 相互作用的强大平台。

papers.title: Structure-based macrocyclization of α-ketoamides leads to potent inhibitors of coronaviral and enteroviral proteases.
papers.abstract: Abstract Viral proteases represent validated targets for direct-acting antivirals and the treatment of associated infections. In co-crystal structures of M pro of SARS-CoV-2 with peptidomimetic inhibitors, we noticed a spatial proximity of sidechains filling the S1’ and S2 pockets, as well as those filling S3 and S1 pockets. To enhance molecular rigidity, the proximal residues were conformationally fixed by macrocyclization. We report the synthesis of two macrocyclic series, i.e. exocyclic nitriles with linked P3 and P1 residues and endocyclic α-ketoamides with linked P1’ and P2 residues, and characterize their binding modes and bioactivities. The 17-membered macrocyclic α-ketoamide 20 f inhibited M pro (IC50 = 370 nM) and exerted anti-SARS-CoV-2 effects (EC50 = 1.9 μM). Leveraging structural similarities between M pro and the 3C pro of enterovirus D68, we describe with two co-crystal structures how α-ketoamide macrocycles bound to and inhibited the enteroviral protease. Notably, 20 f exhibited very potent antiviral activities with EC50‘s of 33, 133, and 146 nM against EV-D68, EV-A71, and CVB3, respectively. The study demonstrates how broad-spectrum activity can be achieved with direct-acting antivirals.

papers.title: Calycosin targets the MAPK-EGR1 signaling axis to inhibit enterovirus 71 replication in cells and human colonic organoids.
papers.abstract: The downstream effectors that mediate the pro‐viral function of the MAPK pathway during enterovirus 71 (EV71) infection remain poorly defined. Here we show that early growth response 1 (EGR1) is independently regulated by each of the three classical MAPK branches including extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK), p38 and c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK), and serves as a common downstream target of these pathways to promote EV71 replication and virus-induced cell death. Furthermore, we found that the natural isoflavone calycosin (CA) from Astragalus membranaceus acts as a regulatory probe of the MAPK-EGR1 axis. CA suppresses EV71-induced expression and phosphorylation of ERK, p38, and JNK, as well as the subsequent upregulation of EGR1, thereby inhibiting both viral replication and virus-induced cell death in conventional cell lines and human colonic organoid infection models. This pro-viral axis is conserved among several enteroviruses, including coxsackievirus B3 and enterovirus D68, and CA exhibits broad-spectrum activity against multiple enteroviruses by targeting this axis. Collectively, our findings establish the MAPK‐EGR1 axis as a key host‐dependency node for EV71 and other enteroviruses, and identify CA as a valuable chemical probe for interrogating this axis. This work not only deepens our understanding of the interplay between enteroviruses such as EV71 and their host, but also provides a mechanistic basis for host‐directed antiviral strategies.

papers.title_zh: 毛蕊异黄酮以 MAPK-EGR1 信号轴为靶点,抑制肠道病毒 71 在细胞和人类结肠类器官中的复制。
papers.source_body_en: The downstream effectors that mediate the pro‐viral function of the MAPK pathway during enterovirus 71 (EV71) infection remain poorly defined. Here we show that early growth response 1 (EGR1) is independently regulated by each of the three classical MAPK branches including extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK), p38 and c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK), and serves as a common downstream target of these pathways to promote EV71 replication and virus-induced cell death. Furthermore, we found that the natural isoflavone calycosin (CA) from Astragalus membranaceus acts as a regulatory probe of the MAPK-EGR1 axis. CA suppresses EV71-induced expression and phosphorylation of ERK, p38, and JNK, as well as the subsequent upregulation of EGR1, thereby inhibiting both viral replication and virus-induced cell death in conventional cell lines and human colonic organoid infection models. This pro-viral axis is conserved among several enteroviruses, including coxsackievirus B3 and enterovirus D68, and CA exhibits broad-spectrum activity against multiple enteroviruses by targeting this axis. Collectively, our findings establish the MAPK‐EGR1 axis as a key host‐dependency node for EV71 and other enteroviruses, and identify CA as a valuable chemical probe for interrogating this axis. This work not only deepens our understanding of the interplay between enteroviruses such as EV71 and their host, but also provides a mechanistic basis for host‐directed antiviral strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 在肠道病毒 71 (EV71) 感染期间介导 MAPK 通路促病毒功能的下游效应器仍不清楚。在这里,我们发现早期生长反应 1 (EGR1) 受到细胞外信号调节激酶 (ERK)、p38 和 c-Jun N 末端激酶 (JNK) 等三个经典 MAPK 分支的独立调节,并作为这些途径的共同下游靶标促进 EV71 复制和病毒诱导的细胞死亡。此外,我们发现黄芪中的天然异黄酮毛蕊异黄酮 (CA) 可以作为 MAPK-EGR1 轴的调节探针。CA 抑制 EV71 诱导的 ERK、p38 和 JNK 表达和磷酸化,以及随后的 EGR1 上调,从而抑制传统细胞系和人结肠类器官感染模型中的病毒复制和病毒诱导的细胞死亡。这种前病毒轴在多种肠道病毒中是保守的,包括柯萨奇病毒 B3 和肠道病毒 D68,CA 通过靶向该轴表现出针对多种肠道病毒的广谱活性。总的来说,我们的研究结果将 MAPK-EGR1 轴确定为 EV71 和其他肠道病毒的关键 宿主 依赖性节点,并将 CA 确定为研究该轴的有价值的化学探针。这项工作不仅加深了我们对EV71等肠道病毒与其宿主之间相互作用的理解,而且为宿主导向的宿主策略提供了机制基础。

papers.title: Changing Etiological Patterns of Pediatric Meningitis: A Three-Year Experience from a Tertiary Pediatric Emergency Hospital in Romania
papers.abstract: Background and Objectives: Pediatric meningitis remains a major diagnostic and therapeutic emergency because clinical presentation may be nonspecific and early etiological distinction directly influences treatment, infection control, and epidemiological surveillance. Although bacterial meningitis has traditionally been emphasized because of its severity, the wider use of rapid molecular methods has increased the detection of viral etiologies. This study aimed to evaluate the etiological distribution of confirmed pediatric meningitis episodes and to assess temporal, age-related, and sex-associated patterns, with particular attention to the observed shift from bacterial toward viral meningitis. Materials and Methods: A retrospective single-center analysis was performed using microbiological data from suspected meningitis episodes investigated between 2023 and 2025 at the “Louis Țurcanu” Emergency Hospital for Children, Timișoara. Confirmed episodes were classified as bacterial, viral, or fungal according to the identified etiological agent. The distribution of suspected and confirmed episodes, annual etiological patterns, age-group differences, sex-associated variation, and identified pathogens were assessed using descriptive statistics and trend analysis. Results: Among 641 suspected episodes, 58 were microbiologically confirmed, corresponding to an overall positivity rate of 9.05%. Viral meningitis was the most frequent etiology, accounting for 30 episodes (51.72%), followed by bacterial meningitis with 22 episodes (37.93%) and fungal meningitis with 6 episodes (10.34%). Etiological distribution changed significantly over the study period: viral episodes increased from 22.22% in 2023 to 77.78% in 2025, while bacterial episodes decreased from 66.67% to 22.22%. Viral meningitis predominated in children aged 1–6 years and was more frequent among male patients, whereas bacterial meningitis remained more frequent in infants. Enterovirus became the dominant identified agent in 2025. Conclusions: The local epidemiology of confirmed pediatric meningitis showed an observed redistribution among confirmed episodes toward viral etiologies, particularly enteroviral meningitis, alongside a proportional decline in bacterial episodes. These findings support continued etiological surveillance and the integration of rapid molecular testing with conventional microbiology in the diagnostic management of suspected pediatric meningitis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the changing etiological patterns of pediatric meningitis over three years at a tertiary pediatric emergency hospital in Romania. It found that viral meningitis, particularly enteroviral meningitis, became more prevalent, increasing from 22.22% in 2023 to 77.78% in 2025, while bacterial meningitis decreased proportionally. The study highlights the importance of rapid molecular testing in identifying viral causes, especially enteroviruses, which became the dominant agent in 2025. These findings suggest a shift in the epidemiology of pediatric meningitis and underscore the need for continued surveillance and improved diagnostic methods. The study's limitations include its single-center and retrospective design, which may limit generalisability, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the reliance on descriptive statistics.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 小儿脑膜炎仍然是主要的诊断和治疗急症,因为临床表现可能是非特异性的,并且早期病因学区分直接影响 治疗、感染控制和流行病学 监测。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 2023 年至 2025 年在蒂米什瓦拉“Louis şurcanu”儿童急救医院调查的疑似脑膜炎事件的微生物学数据进行了回顾性单中心分析。
elements_zh.methods: 使用描述性统计和趋势分析评估可疑和确诊病例的分布、每年的病因模式、年龄组差异、性别相关变异和已识别的病原体。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 641 起疑似病例中,有 58 起经微生物学确诊,总体阳性率为 9.05%。病毒性脑膜炎是最常见的病因,占30例(51.72%),其次是细菌性脑膜炎22例(37.93%)和真菌性脑膜炎6例(10.34%)。研究期间病原学分布发生显着变化:病毒性发病率从2023年的22.22%增加到2025年的77.78%,而细菌性发病率从66.67%下降到22.22%。病毒性脑膜炎在 1-6 岁儿童中占主导地位,并且在男性患者中更为常见,而细菌性脑膜炎在婴儿中仍然更为常见。肠道病毒将在 2025 年成为主要的已识别病毒。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 确诊儿童脑膜炎的局部 流行病学 显示,已观察到的确诊病例向病毒性病因(特别是肠道病毒性脑膜炎)重新分布,同时细菌性脑膜炎发病比例下降。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持持续的病因学 监测 以及快速分子检测与传统微生物学在疑似儿童脑膜炎的诊断管理中的整合。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其单中心设计和回顾性而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。证据是中等的,因为它基于描述性统计和趋势分析。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目的:小儿脑膜炎仍然是主要的诊断和治疗急症,因为临床表现可能是非特异性的,并且早期病因学区分直接影响 治疗、感染控制和流行病学 监测。尽管细菌性脑膜炎因其严重性而历来受到重视,但快速分子方法的广泛使用增加了病毒病原学的检测。本研究旨在评估已确诊的儿童脑膜炎发作的病因分布,并评估时间、年龄相关和性别相关模式,特别关注观察到的从细菌性脑膜炎向病毒性脑膜炎的转变。材料和方法:使用 2023 年至 2025 年在蒂米什瓦拉“Louis şurcanu”儿童急救医院调查的疑似脑膜炎事件的微生物学数据进行了回顾性单中心分析。根据确定的病原,将确诊的发作分为细菌性、病毒性或真菌性。使用描述性统计和趋势分析评估可疑和确诊病例的分布、每年的病因模式、年龄组差异、性别相关变异和已识别的病原体。结果:641例疑似病例中,58例经微生物学确诊,总体阳性率为9.05%。病毒性脑膜炎是最常见的病因,占30例(51.72%),其次是细菌性脑膜炎22例(37.93%)和真菌性脑膜炎6例(10.34%)。研究期间病原学分布发生显着变化:病毒性发病率从2023年的22.22%增加到2025年的77.78%,而细菌性发病率从66.67%下降到22.22%。病毒性脑膜炎在 1-6 岁儿童中占主导地位,并且在男性患者中更为常见,而细菌性脑膜炎在婴儿中仍然更为常见。肠道病毒在 2025 年成为主要的已识别病原体。结论:已确诊的儿科脑膜炎的局部 流行病学 显示,已观察到的已确诊病例向病毒病因(特别是肠道病毒性脑膜炎)重新分布,同时细菌性脑膜炎的发病比例也相应下降。这些发现支持持续的病因学 监测 以及快速分子检测与传统微生物学在疑似儿童脑膜炎的诊断管理中的整合。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 确诊儿童脑膜炎的局部 流行病学 显示,已观察到的确诊病例向病毒性病因(特别是肠道病毒性脑膜炎)重新分布,同时细菌性脑膜炎发病比例下降。
